title: AI Avatars and Digital Human Frameworks
blurb: Open-source frameworks and apps that give an AI agent a face, a voice and a body you can talk to.

title: Digital Human Platforms and APIs
blurb: Hosted services for conversational avatars, interactive video agents and AI characters.

title: Realtime Voice and Video Agent Infrastructure
blurb: Frameworks that stream speech, video and avatar output between users and agents with low latency.

title: Web 3D Runtimes
blurb: Engines and component libraries that render and animate characters in the browser.

title: VRM and glTF Tooling
blurb: Specifications, loaders, importers and optimizers for portable avatar and model formats.

title: Lip-Sync and Facial Animation
blurb: Audio-driven and video-driven face animation, visemes, blendshapes and talking-head models.

title: Avatar and Character Creators
blurb: Tools and models that build 3D characters from sliders, photos, images or text.

title: Rigging, Retargeting and Motion
blurb: Auto-rigging, body models and motion generation for animating characters.

title: Performance Capture and VTubing
blurb: Webcam and sensor tracking, Live2D and 3D puppeteering software for driving avatars live.

title: Agents in 3D Worlds
blurb: Simulators, game environments and frameworks where agents perceive and act inside 3D spaces.
